mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in GDP growth (GDPC1) above 2.5% signals accelerating economic activity, which typically leads to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 rises above 2.5% for 3 months but S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below 100 signals weakening manufacturing output, which typically leads to lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO falls below 100 for 3 months but S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, which typically leads to higher discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS rises above 4.5% for 3 months but S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, the hypothesis is falsified.
